evidence.quote: Facility Tour Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement This FACILITY TOUR CONFIDENTIALITY AND NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement”) is entered into as of this date: ____________ between Hydranautics, a California corporation (“Hydranautics”) and __________________ (“Visitor”).
During the facility tour(s), Visitor will observe Hydranautics’ business operations and facilities which may give Visitor access to some of Hydranautics’ Confidential Information as defined below.
Accordingly, as a condition of and in consideration of touring Hydranautics’ facilities, Visitor agrees that:

1. The term “Confidential Information” shall include all Hydranautics’ trade secrets and information that concerns the confidential business or affairs of Hydranautics and Nitto including without limitation, financial information and reports, business plans, design and construction plans, manufacturing processes, customer lists, employee data, forecasts, strategies, and all other proprietary business information.

2. Visitor agrees and acknowledges that in the course of, or incident to, the tour of Hydranautics’ facilities, Hydranutics may provide to, or Visitor will otherwise become exposed to Hydranautics’ Confidential Information.

3. Visitor agrees to hold the Confidential Information in the strictest confidence, and will exercise at least the same care with respect thereto as it exercises with respect to its’ own confidential or proprietary information and will not without Hydranautics’ consent use, divulge, copy, release, sell, loan or otherwise reveal such Confidential Information to others.
4. Visitor agrees he/she will not remove any document, equipment or other materials from the premises without Hydranautics’ written consent.
Visitor will not photograph, videotape, or otherwise make any record of or preserve any Confidential Information to which he/she may be given access during the facility tour(s).

5. Visitor will abide by all safety regulations, stay within designated areas of the facility per the established tour, and will not leave the touring party without an escort by a Hydranautics authorized employee.
6. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
7. This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties hereto with respect to the subject matter.
8. Visitor understands that his or her breach of this Agreement may subject him or her and his or her employees to liability.

choices.meaning: 完整来源中至少存在一个上述明确类别相关的实际披露许可或禁令候选，证据覆盖形成候选窗口所需的当前单元。
choices.name: candidate_found

choices.meaning: 已检查所供应的完整当前来源，其中没有上述明确类别相关的实际披露许可或禁令。
choices.name: none_in_complete_source

operations.name: class_specific_disclosure_scout_v2
operations.question: 检查完整当前来源，寻找实际生效且明确涉及向雇员、工作人员、承包商、顾问、代理人、代表、律师、会计师或其他专业服务接收者披露受保护信息的许可或禁令。仅定义、人员信息内容、责任描述或一般事实不是候选。若发现，证据应覆盖每个候选的统领句、列表项、接收者定义和紧邻条件；只有检查全部当前单元后才能选择未发现。TRAIN 正例原文：The Confidential Information may be disclosed only to employees or contractors of the Recipient with a “need to know” who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement.；Auditor shall restrict disclosure of such Confidential Information to its employees and/or consultants with a need to know (and advise such employees and/or consultants of the obligations assumed herein), shall use the Confidential Information only for the purposes set forth in the Agreement, and shall not disclose such Confidential Information to any affiliates, subsidiaries, associates and/or third party without prior written approval of the Auditee.

choices.meaning: 完整来源中至少存在一个实际处置义务、处置后留存许可或处置后留存禁令候选。
choices.name: candidate_found

choices.meaning: 已检查所供应的完整当前来源，其中没有实际处置义务或处置后留存规范。
choices.name: none_in_complete_source

operations.name: disposal_retention_scout_v2
operations.question: 检查完整当前来源，寻找要求返还或销毁受保护信息、其副本或衍生材料的实际义务，以及处置后明确允许或禁止留存的规范。证据应覆盖动作、触发事件、材料范围和相邻留存例外；只有检查全部当前单元后才能选择未发现。TRAIN 正例原文：(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.；Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际许可，明确覆盖接收方雇员或工作人员，并覆盖至少一种承包商、顾问、代理人、代表、律师、会计师或专业顾问类别。
choices.name: permission_employees_and_services

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际许可，明确覆盖接收方雇员、工作人员或职员，但没有明确覆盖上述专业服务类别。
choices.name: permission_employees_only

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际许可，明确覆盖至少一种上述专业服务类别，但没有明确覆盖雇员、工作人员或职员。
choices.name: permission_services_only

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际披露许可，但其明确接收者下界不属于前三类。
choices.name: permission_other_recipients

choices.meaning: 窗口形成针对第三方接收者的实际披露禁令，且不是仅针对已定义内部组之外人员的禁令。
choices.name: prohibition_third_parties

choices.meaning: 窗口禁止向接收方及其已定义代表组之外的人披露；该禁令本身不禁止组内披露，也不创造组内许可。
choices.name: prohibition_outsiders_of_actor_group

choices.meaning: 窗口没有形成可归入上述类别的实际许可或禁令。
choices.name: no_operational_rule

operations.name: disclosure_effect_profile_v2
operations.question: 把整个供应窗口作为一个连续来源片段判断。它是否形成向明确接收者类别披露受保护信息的实际许可，或者形成相关禁令？接收者定义和交叉条款只能作为上下文，不得把定义本身当作许可。证据应包括产生所选效力和接收者下界的原文单元。TRAIN 示例：The Receiving Party will disclose information it receives from SINTEC only to selected members of its staff and only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case. => permission_employees_only；Receiving Party therefore agrees that neither it nor its Representatives will at any time make any independent business or personal use of, retain, copy, divulge, disclose, reveal or communicate to any other person or organization (except as expressly authorized in writing by Originating Party, as required to analyze the Business Relationship or as required to fulfill Receiving Party’s obligations to Originating Party) any Confidential Information. => prohibition_outsiders_of_actor_group。

choices.meaning: 许可明确要求获准接收者具有知悉必要性。
choices.name: need_to_know_required

choices.meaning: 许可明确限制在为所述目的必要的范围，但没有明确使用知悉必要性要求。
choices.name: extent_necessary_required

choices.meaning: 许可同时明确要求知悉必要性并限制披露范围。
choices.name: need_and_extent_required

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际许可，但完整供应窗口没有明确施加上述访问范围条件。
choices.name: no_access_limit_in_window

choices.meaning: 窗口没有形成可评价访问条件的实际披露许可。
choices.name: no_operational_permission

operations.name: disclosure_access_profile_v2
operations.question: 若整个供应窗口形成实际类别披露许可，许可明确施加何种访问范围条件？证据必须来自当前窗口，不得从缺失文字推断。TRAIN 示例：with a “need to know” => need_to_know_required；only to the extent absolutely necessary for SINTEC's specified or authorized purposes in each case. => extent_necessary_required。

choices.meaning: 获准接收者必须受书面保密协议或明确书面保密约束。
choices.name: written_confidentiality_required

choices.meaning: 获准接收者须承担、遵守或被告知保密义务，但窗口没有明确要求书面形式。
choices.name: confidentiality_duty_without_written_form

choices.meaning: 窗口形成实际许可，但完整供应窗口没有明确施加上述保密保障。
choices.name: no_safeguard_in_window

choices.meaning: 窗口没有形成可评价保障条件的实际披露许可。
choices.name: no_operational_permission

operations.name: disclosure_safeguard_profile_v2
operations.question: 若整个供应窗口形成实际类别披露许可，它对获准接收者明确施加哪种保密保障？证据可包括统领前提、接收者项和紧邻保障条款。TRAIN 示例：who are subject to written confidentiality agreements sufficient to carry out the intent of this Agreement. => written_confidentiality_required；and advise such employees and/or consultants of the obligations assumed herein => confidentiality_duty_without_written_form。

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由协议到期或终止触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: agreement_termination_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由参与者服务终止触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: service_termination_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由业务或工作关系终止或到期触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: relationship_termination_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由明示期限前未建立业务关系触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: relationship_nonformation_deadline_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由披露方请求触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: request_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成由协议终止或到期、或者披露方请求触发的返还和/或销毁义务。
choices.name: agreement_termination_or_request_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成处置后保留特定信息的实际许可或例外。
choices.name: retention_allowed_after_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口明确禁止在处置后保留特定信息。
choices.name: retention_forbidden_after_disposal

choices.meaning: 窗口形成其他明确的处置或处置后留存规范。
choices.name: other_disposal_or_retention

choices.meaning: 窗口没有形成实际处置义务或处置后留存规范。
choices.name: no_operational_rule

operations.name: disposal_retention_profile_v2
operations.question: 把整个供应窗口作为连续片段判断其实际处置或处置后留存效果。必须保留动作、材料范围和精确事件区别；请求、协议终止、服务终止、业务关系终止和未建立业务关系期限不得互换。证据应同时包括统领动作与触发或留存文字。TRAIN 示例：Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service. => service_termination_disposal；5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship. => relationship_termination_disposal。
